name: Fortunate Ruler
text:
**Fortunate Ruler**

Your good luck shines on your people, even in the most
 trying times.

**Prerequisites**: Hold the Ruler leadership role for a kingdom.

**Benefit**: During a kingdom’s Event phase, once an
 event’s type and danger level has been determined, you
 may choose to roll twice on the applicable kingdom or
 settlement table and choose either result. You must
 declare you are using this feat before the results of the
 initial roll are revealed.
